wiring_experiment.interpretation: A nonzero difference demonstrates computational use of recurrent edges. It does not show that this wiring is better than random wiring or that Celeste rooms clear.

learning_experiment.interpretation: This exercises the same optimizer used by LEARN on a disposable model copy. A changed weight verifies training, not an improved game clear rate.
